reason: As a salon owner whose cousin does my books for $600 a year, I trust A more. It tells me plainly about the price rise and the three missed deadlines, and it doesn't promise I'll save on my accountant. B is warmer, but it leans on the 'your accountant will charge less' pitch, which doesn't move me when my cousin is that cheap, and it states the $800 saving as fact when the client only said so.
